tips: Load $35 onto your digital Suica card while waiting at MSP so you're ready to tap the moment you land.
Complete Visit Japan Web tonight and screenshot the QR codes for offline access at immigration.
Hit the Limousine Bus desk at Haneda before SIM card lines to secure seats for the whole squad.
If Ichiran's line is apocalyptic, pivot one stop north to Shin-Okubo Koreatown for KFC and cheese dogs at midnight.
Shibuya Sky sunset slots sell out fast; if unavailable, Mag's Park rooftop or Hikarie 11F Sky Lobby offer great free crossing views.
If jet lag hits hard, swap the Blue Cave walk for an early nomihodai and call it a night before 23:00.
If Tokyo Skytree queue is insane, Asahi Beer Hall's 22F Sky Room next door offers the same river view for the price of a beer.
For the Akiba deep-divers, Super Potato → Mandarake Complex → Taito HEY is a 3-hour vortex; set a hard regroup time.
After Tsukiji, walk 10 minutes to Hama-rikyu Gardens for an Edo tidal garden digestif and island tea house.
If squads split in Ginza, hit the free Ginza Six rooftop or the Seiko clock chime as easy regroup points.
December offers peak Fuji clarity—if the coastal view is the priority, the Fuji Excursion to Kawaguchiko is a stunning alternative.
If legs are cooked after the Daibutsu, skip the Enoshima climb and soak at Enospa onsen overlooking the bay instead.
Run the Airbnb washer during dinner so everyone lands in Kyoto with a clean kit.
Pack FIRST before hitting Golden Gai—bags must close tonight for the morning train.
Sit on the LEFT side of the Nozomi shinkansen for a chance at a Fuji view around minute 40.
Scout Nintendo Kyoto in Takashimaya today, but buy in Osaka—Kansai-exclusive merch exists.
Past Yotsutsuji at Fushimi Inari, the crowds hit zero—push 45 more minutes for the full summit loop and bragging rights.
For a deep sake cut, hit Sake Bar Yoramu (8 seats) tonight; say 'osusume de' and let the bartender guide you.
SKIP Wakakusa-yama climb—the mountain closes to hikers the second Sunday of December, well before we arrive.
If Kyoto wakes up white, override the itinerary: race to Kinkaku-ji at opening for Japan's rarest gold-and-snow photo.
Order KFC Christmas buckets well in advance or expect a 2-hour line—it's a sacred, wildly popular Japanese tradition.
Buy two Rikuro's jiggly cheesecakes near Namba station; they do not survive the night.
If Express Passes are sold out, use early-entry tickets + app timed-entry sprint + single-rider lines to cut Mario Kart waits by 60%.
For the non-USJ faction, Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan + Tempozan wheel + Santa Maria bay cruise is a full alternative Christmas 20 min away.
This is the longest day of the trip—anyone redlining should skip Miyajima, do the museum unhurried, and meet at Hiroshima station.
For the okonomiyaki schism: Nagata-ya by the Dome is the locals' counter-pick to Okonomimura. Split, eat, debate on the ferry.
Buy a 551 Horai butaman 4-pack from Namba station BEFORE the crab dinner—they sell out nightly and house breakfast depends on it.
If 13 days of walking have collected their tax, swap Umeda Sky for Spa World's gloriously kitsch mega-baths in Shinsekai.
Do a tax-free paperwork check tonight: ensure receipts match passports and purchases are accessible—customs CAN ask on exit.
Kobe beef budget fork: $22 (¥3,500) bowls and croquette stands around Sannomiya deliver 70% of the experience at 40% of the price.
Sit on the LEFT side (Seats A) of the Nozomi east for Fuji's encore view.
Buy Japanese whisky AFTER security at HND; if you have a checked bag transfer at MSP, do NOT bury it or you'll lose it to liquid rules.

globalTips: With the USD/JPY rate at ~161.68, your dollar stretches far—rely on digital Suica/credit cards for the best rates and avoid airport currency exchanges with high fees.
For a group of 8, always split into two squads of 4 for seated meals (izakayas, ramen counters) to bypass massive wait times, and use konbini resupply runs to avoid 8-person checkout bottlenecks.

Keep all tax-free receipts together and passport-stamped purchases accessible in your carry-on; Japanese customs can and does check them on exit, and a 10-minute organization session now beats a Dec 29 panic.
